scope.handshake_product: Research Illustrator/InDesign/Figma original workflows versus selected pinned Craft function bodies and current Studio contracts
scope.repo_governance: Owned design-original.json only; no spec/MT/status edits

inspection_limits: No builds/tests/upstream execution/vendor GUI/binary decompilation/Git mutations
Native control automation unavailable; installed sample scripts are readable resources, not native GUI or engine proof
Exact local selected bytes inspected; not exhaustive source audit; no runtime or parity PASS
All fixture cases proposed; original reference documents/exports/font/profile bytes and original traces not acquired
Existing 5484-MT scope and IDs remain preserved; no new replacement task IDs allocated

sources.claim: Preview eye controls affect display only; output plates have separate print controls. Registration includes spot plates; screen preview excludes printer marks, screening, trapping and emulsion proof.
Object/group/layer appearance supports multiple fills/strokes, ordered effects and visibility; scope and order are authored semantics.
Expand and Expand Appearance are distinct editing operations; appearance may disable Expand until appearance expansion.
Pen gesture Spacebar-drag repositions the current anchor while drawing; interaction state matters.

PDF export exposes independent structure/hyperlink/bookmark/layer flags, effective destination/output-condition readbacks, and simulateOverprint converts spot inks to process with validity restrictions.
Articles define content reading order independently of visual layout; tagging-order and tagged-PDF export flags activate it.
World-Ready uses Harfbuzz by default and exposes a legacy-engine preference; compatibility depends on engine choice.
HUG is valid for auto-layout frames/text, FILL for auto-layout children; invalid use throws rather than silently adapting.
counterAxisSpacing applies to HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL wrapping frames and is positive; reactions, min/max constraints and mode resolution are separately represented.
BOOLEAN/TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP property names include unique # identifiers; full property name is required by related APIs.
A reaction requires a trigger and nonempty ordered action list.
Multiple actions and conditional branching are authored prototype behaviors, beyond static screen links.

steps: Create CMYK artboards with bleed; place linked raster with pinned profile
Draw/edit paths and compound holes; author multiple fills/strokes and scoped effects
Reuse symbols/global spot swatches; proof chosen output without converting authority colors
Check overprint/knockout and per-plate coverage; preserve separate preview/output flags
Export editable native plus chosen PDF/X with marks/bleed; reopen and inspect plates/geometry/unsupported receipts
Import IDML with links/fonts/parent pages/styles and preservation bytes
Compose threaded multilingual stories with independent scope/engine and document CJK tables
Apply variable axes, table/footnote/running-header/cross-reference semantics and inspect overset
Author Articles reading order independently of stacking; tag headings/figures/tables
Export press PDF and accessible PDF/EPUB/HTML; independently reopen structural and visual results
Create component property schemas with stable IDs, variants and nested instances
Author nested auto-layout/constraints with legal sizing and clamps
Swap component/variant preserving compatible overrides and reporting losses
Author ordered reaction actions, conditions and interactive component state
Export/reimport and compare semantic layout/action graphs; replay prototype with isolated sessions

control_semantics.rule: Preview plate eye toggles are display state; output plate enablement is export/print state; undo/receipts must distinguish them.
Object/group/layer and per-fill/per-stroke effect targets, order, hide/expand operations are distinct. Pen modifiers are gesture-state controls.
Logical article order, page stacking, thread order and tab order are different stored concerns; tagged flag alone does not prove accessibility.
Sizing mode has node-context legality; component property identity is full stable key; prototype trigger requires ordered nonempty actions.

craft_findings.finding: DesignCraft fill overprint is detected but not exported; spot Separation support alone cannot prove production separations.
craft_findings.mitigation: Bind a shared ink-aware export/render plan; reject or disclose unsupported overprint before promotion; preserve separate preview and output controls.

craft_findings.finding: Actual PDF/X postprocessing writes an OutputIntent using Generic CMYK, independent of chosen export destination; warnings are returned in an otherwise successful ExportReport when intent creation/check fails.
craft_findings.mitigation: Use chosen profile bytes/output condition, expose effective readback and separate file-produced from standard-conformant status. Require independent object/standard inspection.

craft_findings.finding: Tagged PDF exists. Its inspected tag_tree emits stories/figures in first appearance order, with heading/blockquote/P mappings. This path does not consult an article-order input; do not infer complete accessible publication output from tagged=true.
craft_findings.mitigation: Resolve canonical content order for PDF/EPUB/HTML; independently inspect structure tree, table semantics, alt text, language and keyboard/tab order.

craft_findings.finding: IDML reader caps initial capacity but reads every ZIP entry fully; duplicate names overwrite HashMap entries; missing included parts continue. Anchored groups containing TextFrame are not handled by the has_text=false branch.
craft_findings.mitigation: Bound inflated total/part bytes and part count before reading; reject duplicate mandatory parts; preserve unhandled anchored content with source bytes and loss receipt rather than claim full fidelity.

craft_findings.finding: DesignCraft composition selects greedy for tab-containing paragraphs or glyph count over 4000 even when paragraph composer was selected. Shaping function uses vertical/contextual paths and bypasses word cache for RTL; real implementation exists but exact complex-script parity remains unproven.
craft_findings.mitigation: Report effective breaker/shaper/font bytes/axes/language/features; retain requested scope and avoid silent composer substitution. Compare glyph clusters, line breaks, frame/page boundaries and overset.

craft_findings.finding: MT-200 still mandates four composer choices from superseded STU-TYP-010. Current spec explicitly supersedes it with two independent axes, all six combinations, plus registry precedence; MT-30904/30905 already cover current clauses.
craft_findings.mitigation: Preserve MT-200 ID and original intent, replace stale acceptance with current two-axis scope and explicit ownership links to derived MTs; do not add duplicate feature scope.

craft_findings.finding: STU-DS-144 and MT-33100 restrict wrapping to HORIZONTAL. Current official Figma node API says counter-axis spacing applies to HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL wrapping frames. This is a documented source-semantic mismatch, not an observed Figma GUI result.
craft_findings.mitigation: Root should reconcile vertical-wrap legality and track original capture/version provenance before changing closed enum behavior; retain original IDs. Distinguish Studio-native negative spacing extension from Figma counterAxisSpacing positivity.

craft_findings.finding: DesignCraft PDF lib header claims tagged PDF/bookmarks/hyperlinks and OutputIntent absent, but current export body sets tag tree, emits annotations and invokes make_pdfx4. Header TODO is stale and cannot establish absence. Earlier early-message absence claim retracted.
craft_findings.mitigation: Base adoption inventory on reachable function bodies and output fixtures, not headers, roadmap counts or test names.

craft_findings.finding: Inspected VectorCraft fx path separates object effects from per-fill/per-stroke effects and has container appearance. Publication stories/frames and Figma properties/variants/prototypes cannot be replaced by these vector appearance primitives. No absence claim is made about all uninspected VectorCraft code.
craft_findings.mitigation: Reuse shared geometry/color/fonts and UI controls while retaining appearance, publication flow and component/prototype semantic owners.

spec_mt_deltas.change: Add independent ink/output-intent/standard proof and explicit unsupported-result semantics; do not add duplicate prepress features.
Use article/structure/package source reconciliation rather than screenshot/export-success proxies.
Preserve original composer intent and ID, reconcile to current two-axis contract and existing derived owners.
Reconcile horizontal-only wrap restriction with current official vertical-wrap API semantics and retain version provenance.
Preserve full foreign component-property identity on import, override receipt and action order; test distinct semantic owners.

fixture_gaps.case: CMYK packaging art with two named spots, 100% K small type overprinting cyan, white knock-out, translucent group over two spots, and registration marks. Toggle preview plate eye without changing exported plate set.
fixture_gaps.oracle: Independent PDF object inspection for Separation/DeviceN, overprint fill/stroke flags and output-intent bytes; ink-aware per-plate render comparison against approved original exports. Composite screenshot is insufficient.

fixture_gaps.case: Export same document to two distinct pinned CMYK ICC profiles and an incompatible target; include placed PDF with object-stream/xref-stream/transparency groups.
fixture_gaps.oracle: Extract and hash embedded profile, inspect OutputCondition identifiers/effective receipt, independent PDF/X conformance and per-plate render. Failed conformance must not be labelled conformant.

fixture_gaps.case: Three-column article with sidebar visually above main text but ordered after it; threaded story spans pages, table with headers, figure alt text, decorative parent item, language changes and links/forms.
fixture_gaps.oracle: Independent structure-tree traversal and text extraction order plus reader/focus path; compare PDF/EPUB/HTML logical order. Pixel match can coexist with wrong accessibility.

fixture_gaps.case: IDML containing anchored TextFrame within Group, missing referenced Story part, duplicate designmap.xml, unknown namespace extension, large inflated part and external link outside resolver capability.
fixture_gaps.oracle: Independent XML/package/source reconciliation; preserve source bytes and identify unmaterialized content in receipt; bounded memory/cancellation and fail-closed required-part behavior.

fixture_gaps.case: Arabic/Hebrew mixed RTL/LTR digits, Indic conjuncts, Japanese vertical ruby/kinsoku/warichu, variable axes including custom axis, missing fallback glyph, tabular paragraph and 3999/4001-glyph every-line paragraphs.
fixture_gaps.oracle: Pinned font bytes and original-engine/version export; compare Unicode clusters, glyph IDs/advances, line-break/frame/page/overset metrics. All six composer combinations and named-registry precedence. Sharing Harfbuzz family is not parity proof.

fixture_gaps.case: Nested vertical and horizontal wrap frames; text HUG versus child FILL, min/max clamps, absolute badge, negative Studio gap, positive Figma cross gap, strokes-in-layout and baseline alignment.
fixture_gaps.oracle: Official node-schema roundtrip plus pinned original export of sizes/transforms, typed legality errors and screenshot comparison; no silent coercion of illegal FILL/HUG.

fixture_gaps.case: Two TEXT properties with same display title and different # IDs; nested instance swaps and preserved/drop-reported overrides; variable mode inherited then overridden; hover/press variant with ordered set-variable, conditional and navigate actions.
fixture_gaps.oracle: Independent semantic node/action diff and deterministic interaction trace; ensure instance state isolation, undo group, revision checks and no duplicate mutation after lost reply. Static symbol render is insufficient.

fixture_gaps.case: Logo with multiple fills/strokes, per-item offset, group opacity, live brush/width profile; Pen Spacebar anchor move mid-drag, Alt handle conversion, Escape cancellation and keyboard-only appearance reordering.
fixture_gaps.oracle: Original command/action trace and live-vs-expanded geometry/appearance/render comparison; pen input replay and accessibility focus/labels. Requires native original controls unavailable in this session.

installed_readable_resources.finding: SplitStory documents deleting overset text and losing inter-frame hyphenation, then duplicates frames and removes originals backwards.
installed_readable_resources.derived_control: Do not adopt destructive sample behavior implicitly; require exact loss receipt and reversible command.

installed_readable_resources.finding: TabUtilities uses insertion-point/frame-column geometry and explicit alignment/leader; displays dialogs and forces interaction. It was read only, never run.
installed_readable_resources.derived_control: Cursor-coordinate tabs and column-edge tabs are different commands; model APIs use explicit structured geometry, not foreground scripts.

production_controls: Each future semantic owner and reusable bound control requires Argus structured state/operator screenshots, model commands, UserManual/FR/internal_diagnostics/Palmistry obligations per active HBR; bounded jobs/bytes/cancellation before feature adoption; shared SurrealDB/EventLedger authority. This report does not invent executable proof commands.
restart: Review each finding against its exact hash/range; root decides edits. Acquire missing original fixtures before any runtime-parity conclusion.

read_probe_failure.cause: Python cp1252 stdout could not encode U+2192 in IDML source
read_probe_failure.recovery: Subsequent bounded reads set sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding=utf-8); root informed; shared gameplan unchanged
